description: Schema-free CLI that finds unused GraphQL operations, fragments, and orphaned .gql files by searching source for their generated names.
rules: gqlPrune reports candidates, not proof. Review each finding before deleting an operation, fragment, or file.

Set usagePatterns and fragmentUsagePatterns in gqlPrune.config.yaml when the project does not use the GraphQL Code Generator hook and Document naming. Without them, used operations are reported as unused.
In scripts and CI, pass --json. Stdout then carries only the JSON report and diagnostics go to stderr.
Pass --inline to include gql`...` documents embedded in TypeScript and JavaScript source. By default only .gql and .graphql files are read.
gqlPrune 2.x and later need Node.js 20 or newer. The command is gqlprune, lowercase.
